content: Devid ọbhaang obo kwa Saul
K'ogbe kwa Saul ọkk'ọpa, Devid obina kẹ da okk'anọng p'Amalẹk okhema okhuna, okwu owobha iwu ifa ka Ziklag.
Ottong iwu ittaan, ojinọng wani kw'ofon k'ibhingabe sa Saul okwu, ttara ọbara f'ọkk'ẹ ọjaakhi ka for, ọmaana ọkpọhm k'eho. Mada opyiri k'ibe sa Devid owobh, otto okhubha m'irerek k'ikpokpobha.
Devid e, ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Kọ afon man akwu ma o?” Ojinọng nwa obhina bi, “Kaam nnọbhi k'ibhingabe s'agbong-nọng p'Israẹl e.”
Devid ọbọbh bi, “Bọng odik wọ otto? Gbaakh-m.” Ojinọng nwa obhina bi, “Asoja haabhada p'Israẹl arọbhi k'egbong-dam, haabhada abira ape. Saul ọmaana nnwa kwẹ Jonatan akk'abira apa e.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọbọbh odikkobh nwa kw'otzim ẹkkaabha nda okwu bi, “Kọ areng yan aronga bi, Saul ọmaana nnwa kwẹ Jonatan akk'apa?”

Odikkobh nwa oben bi, “Odik ode bi, kaam nda k'egbegbeho cha Gilboa, nna nda nttema da Saul on-otto ọkpẹkhi ọkhọhn fẹ, ttara bi, akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr, ọmaana ayaari-nnyanyaang am-akhubh-ẹ ẹkhọma-ẹkhọma.
Mada ọbhakhi ore-m, oyer-m, nkhera mben bi, ‘Kkeri kaam ma e.’
“Ọbọbh-m bi, ‘Kọ ade bọng ọnọng o?’ “Kaam e, mmina bi, ‘Kaam mfon Amalẹk e.’
“Mẹ wọ, oben-m bi, ‘Rọkhi abaang-m, afhu-m! Kaam nna nwobh ka mbọhk s'obo, yina, ndimi nji iwọhng ka e.’

“Mẹ wọ, mbẹ-ẹ m'ẹbhabhaanga, mfhẹ-ẹ, okhuri da nne bi, mada ọkk'ọtta mẹ, akpen dọk kofha oruk. Nnwọr-ẹ ivaarkpo s'ọfọr k'eho, ọmaana ogimma kw'okhe k'ọbọhk. Nkk'pyẹ ndima nkwu ma bi, nnang kọ itta kwaam e.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọmaana ajinọng pẹ biphyir abọkha ọbara fa bẹ afọr ka for ajaakhi.

Bẹ awobha ka nkwu-osisi, abira abhom amọng, atzim ọchattọhk maa, ẹchọhkha etto. Wa bẹ asi mando, okhuri obo kwa Saul ope ọmaana nnwa kwẹ Jonatan, ọmaana agbong-nọng p'anọng p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ttara anọng p'Israẹl, okhuri bi, bẹ atzim ọkkangkkaang afhu bẹ.
Devid e, ọbọbh odikkobh nwuma kw'otzim ẹkkaabha nda okwu bi, “Kọ afon man o?” Ojinọng nwuma obhina bi, “Kaam nde nnwa kw'okhekhen-nọng kw'ofon Amalẹk.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Osi yan kw'ira on-ojor bi, ayaangi ọbọhk kwọ, afhu ọnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ana obyengi k'eho?”
Mẹ wọ, Devid oyeri ojinọng kwẹ wani, oben bi, “Rọhng, atza afhẹ-ẹ!” Ofona mẹ, obun-ẹ ofhu, ojinọng nwuma ope.
Ode cha Devid ọkk'ẹ obena bi, “Izi sọ ibhaakhi ikpan kọ ọkhaam. Da akk'ẹmma chọ atzima asi ẹjaakhi bi, ‘Kaam nkk'ọnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ana obyengi k'eho mfha e.’ ”
Ebomọng cha Devid ọkkọhni k'obo kwa Saul ọmaana Jonatan
Devid ọkkọhni ebomọng nda otzima ojima Saul ọmaana nnwa kwẹ Jonatan.
Obiro ọnang ẹfa bi, bẹ akpebhi ajinọng pa Juda ebomọng nda ch'oyuk. (Bẹ akkẹri ẹmọng nda ka nnwẹr kwa Jasha).

content.text: “Israẹl o, ajibhada pọ ape ayima ka mgbegbeho sọ.
Kpebh e, kkeri odem kw'afanọng atto e!
“Bọng odik nwa ka Gat kàgbaak,
Bọng kwẹ ka mkpaanga-den s'Ashkẹlọn kàgbaak,
oni mando ode, aminava p'anọng pa Philistiya, awobha k'ọdadaami,
oni mando ode, aminava p'anọng p'ani ọkpakkọrikkọ asi, awobha k'ọdadaami.
“Mgbegbeho sa Gilboa o,
bọng abonisi obiro ode ẹrọng, káre e.
Kaambi k'iwoni rọ, achimọma pa nnanga káwọm,
okhuri bi, mẹ wọ kwa bẹ alukhi ọkhọhnkpa kw'afanọng,
bẹ ọkhọhnkpa kwa Saul ana dọk kabọhr.
Ofon k'izi s'anọng pa ape,
ofona k'ayaara p'afanọng,
oyuk kwa Jonatan nnama-nnam kọkpa.
Ọkkangkkaang kwa Saul nnam k'idukhi kobiro ọkpa.
“Mada iwa Saul ọmaana Jonatan arukhi akpen,
bẹ akhaam idadaakha, abira asi ọphyaam anang ayok;
k'obo, bẹ ayok kabira abhaangi.
Wa bẹ aphyebhi ayọhnga okye-nọhn,
bẹ akhaama ẹfa ayọhnga nkye.
“Aminava p'Israẹl o,
bọng mom Saul e,
kw'ọnangi bọng ọbara fa for f'ode iho-iho, ọmaana agimma,
kw'odok nnya sabọng ttara ẹfanginẹ-kpo pya gol.
“Kpebh e! Kkeri odem kw'afanọng akk'atta k'egbong e!
Jonatan ope oyima ka mgbegbeho sọ.
Jonatan ọgbaanọkka kwaam o, kaam mmomi kọ e,
kọ wa abar-m odik kpọng-kpọng.
Idadaakha s'iwa akhaam ttar-m ikkoni-okkoni,
ikkoni ọtzam iyọhnga idadaakha sa kwanọng.
“Kkeri odem kw'afanọng akk'atta!
Egbongkpo ekk'ekhibhi biphyir-phyir!”
